messages:
Nina: Heads-up - rooftop dev meetup tonight. Small crowd (~120). Need quick sync on booth plan, swag triage, speaker handoff, and webinar follow-up signups.
Raj: I'll run load-in. ETA 17:00. Can BoothCo still do banner install?
BoothCo: Yes - crew arrives 16:50. Two banners + one pop-up. Bring weight bags for wind.
Tess: Swag update: 80 hoodies (S-XL mix), 150 postcard 'benchmarks' prints, 300 stickers. Printer says postcards have a smear risk - might reject 30.
Leo: For demos: we'll run 3x 20-min rotations, 10-min Q&A. DevRel on standby. Demo laptop + hotspot ready.
Kelsey: Permit is ok until 22:30. Security needs contact name on manifest.
Nina: Contact = Raj +1-628-555-0199. Security to call if issues.
Tess: Lead capture plan: QR -> short form (email, role, interest). Auto-tag utm=rooftop23. Export to CSV and push to Outreach daily.
Leo: Suggest: postcard QR points to a short benchmark narrative page + "Join webinar" button. If they click, pre-fill webinar sign-up.
Nina: Good. Can someone draft 1-sentence line for the postcard landing CTA?
Tess: Draft: "Compare latency & cost across real prompts — scan to see the numbers, join our expert webinar."
Raj: AV note: projector limited. We'll rely on lightning demo + live laptop. Bring HDMI and USB-C adapters.
Kelsey: Power: venue provides 2 outlets. Booth needs 6-outlet strip. Anyone bring one?
Leo: I have a 6-outlet. Bringing it.
Nina: Swag triage if printer fails: prioritize postcards with QR + 100 hoodies as team giveaways; stickers as free extras after demo.
BoothCo: Shipping manifests: all crates arriving 17:05. Driver will send picture of manifest.
Logi-bot: Reminder: Vendor insurance doc required. BoothCo uploaded at 14:12.
Tess: Content plan: record two 30s clips: 1) demo highlight, 2) attendee reaction + CTA. Leo can shoot. Anyone edit short 45s for socials tomorrow?
Leo: I can rough-cut on the train home; needs approvals by 10:00 tomorrow.
Nina: Webinar tie-in: add webinar date in follow-up email. Tess + Raj to own follow-up template.
Tess: I'll draft follow-up copy: 1) "Thanks for stopping by" 2) benchmark snapshot 3) webinar CTA. Will post in #marketing-copy by 21:00.
Raj: Can we add a small sticker on demo table that says "Scan for benchmark + webinar"? Helps conversion.
Kelsey: I'll print 30 table stickers pre-event.
Nina: Emergency plan: if speaker cancels, run a 20-min fireside Q&A with DevRel. Leo to moderate.
Leo: Roger.
Tess: For faster imports to HubSpot, use this CSV header set:
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,utm_source,interest,notes
```
Tess: Example row:
```
jamie@startup.co,Jamie,Lee,StartupCo,rooftop23,embeddings,ask pricing follow-up
```
Nina: One last ask: please DM me any attendee names who request follow-up so outreach can prioritize. Meeting at merch staging at 16:45.
Raj: See you at 16:45.
BoothCo: Manifest signed, crew en route.
Logi-bot: Weather alert: light wind advisory 18:00-20:00. Secure banners.
Kelsey: Noted - will double-weight banners.
Nina: Thanks team! Let's keep updates short in this thread. :sparkles:
